details: Bitcoin (BTC) has rebounded significantly, climbing above $80,000, with Ethereum (ETH) also experiencing strong gains. This rally across the cryptocurrency market coincides with a broader uptick on Wall Street following the conclusion of the US midterm elections. The positive market sentiment, driven by eased political uncertainty and substantial short liquidations in Bitcoin, occurred despite recent outflows from spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80K as Crypto Markets Rally Post-US Midterms

details: The cryptocurrency market has displayed a notably muted response to the significant $6.3 billion security breach that occurred at Binance on October 29. This subdued reaction, even amidst Bitcoin's recovery post-US midterm elections, suggests a growing maturity and resilience within the crypto industry, indicating that such incidents may have less systemic impact than in the past.
title: Crypto Market Shows Maturity as Binance Hack Reaction Muted

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a 9.5% surge in its price over the last 24 hours after the Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) decided to abandon a controversial plan to redirect approximately 98,000 ZEC from the developer fund to future mining rewards. This reversal followed significant pushback from ZEC holders. Additionally, Zcash is anticipating its NU7 upgrade around November 5, which aims to reduce block time.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Jumps 9.5% After Community Halts Fund Redirect Plan

details: Despite the broader cryptocurrency market's rally, US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) continued to register net outflows, totaling over $200 million combined in recent days. This trend highlights ongoing caution among institutional investors, indicating that while the overall market shows strength, sustained institutional buying interest in these products has yet to fully return.
title: Spot Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs See Continued Outflows Amid Market Recovery

details: A large transaction involving 101 million Tether (USDT) was observed on November 4, transferred from an unidentified cryptocurrency wallet to the major exchange Binance. Such substantial transfers are typically monitored closely by market participants as they can often precede significant trading activity or shifts in market liquidity and price volatility.
title: Unknown Wallet Transfers 101M USDT to Binance
